Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

lobsteR (development version)

  • New functions to clean LOBSTER data: lobster_clean() turns one day’s message and order book files into a per-message table of continuous trading, lobster_snapshots() aggregates it to a regular time grid, and lobster_process() runs both, also straight from a .7z archive. lobster_crosses(), lobster_halts() and lobster_log() report the auctions, trading halts and dropped messages; lobster_file_info() and lobster_archive_files() parse LOBSTER file names.
  • The cleaning follows the Tidy Finance blog code, with these corrections: hidden trades are signed against the quote just before the trade, in integer prices, and those at the midquote stay unsigned (new midpoint_volume); signed volume is summed per message and is missing only without trades; time weights are split at interval edges and empty intervals carry the book state; halts are paired by type, found before the time filter and last to the close if trading does not resume; opening and closing crosses are detected for any trading hours (e.g. early closes) and reported; snapshots carry n_messages, n_trades, halted and depth-truncation flags; time stamps are in America/New_York.
  • Crossed books give NA book variables. One-sided books give NA midquote and spread, and depth 0 on the empty side.
  • Order books are read in blocks and only as deep as the depth measures need, so memory use does not depend on the number of levels.
  • A polars translation with the same functions and output is in python/.
